# the changes that build EVERY engine of UE5_ENGINE_ROOTS on a ci/ push (scripts/unreal_engines.py);
# any other ci/ change builds the newest engine only, and every engine builds after landing on main
# and weekly. Read by scripts/changed_paths.py decide (same pattern syntax as .github/paths/).
# Listed: what the engine version itself compiles or links against — the plugin's C++ and
# shaders, the C header it includes, the HLSL emitters whose text the engine's shader compiler
# compiles, the example that generates the plugin's corpus shaders, and this workflow and its
# scripts.
